shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- skill uikit steps ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"toast|uikit|Step 1|Required setup|package-routing\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- App.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,200p' src/App.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- main.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,200p' src/main.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- toast docs ---' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*toast*' -o -path '*Toast*' | head -60 && printf '%s\\n' '--- setup docs ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/setup.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Toast|Toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -type f | rg 'toast|toaster|Toaster|Toast' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; printf '\\n--- docs list ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -type f | grep -i toast | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Toaster|Toast\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- hook ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; printf '\\n--- component ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; printf '\\n--- with ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/withToaster.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/withToaster.js; printf '\\n--- provider js ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js; printf '\\n--- button typedef ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | rg \"Toaster|Button|Flex|Box\" | head -80; printf '\\n--- props exp ---\\n'; rg -n \"export .*Toaster|export .*Button|export .*Box\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: src/App.tsx @@ +import { Button, Toaster, ToasterComponent, ToasterProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit'; +import React from 'react'; + export function App() { - return
{/* TODO: implement the requested component */}
; + const toaster = React.useRef(new Toaster()).current; + + return ( + + + + + ); } *** End Patch PATCH npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "command -v apply_patch || find / -name 'apply_patch' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; git diff -- src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba src/App.tsx && git status --short && git diff -- src/App.tsx'
